Eid.Note.Git: 支持 GitHub、Gitee 的 HTTPS 地址；只有 GitHub 域名会按「GitHub 加速」开关经中转访问，其余直连。同名目录已存在时会加后缀另装一份，不会覆盖已有扩展。

HTTPS addresses from GitHub and Gitee work; only GitHub hosts follow the GitHub acceleration switch and go through the relay, everything else connects directly. If a folder with the same name already exists, a suffix is added and a separate copy is installed — existing extensions are never overwritten.
Eid.Label.PickOffline: 选择 .zip 离线包（可多选）
Eid.Note.Offline: 离线包需包含 manifest.json；压缩包里套了一层目录也能认出来。同一批里有两个同名的包会整组标为无效——装出来会是 x 和 x-2，分不清哪个才是要的。装完会自动启用，可在列表中关闭。

An offline package must contain manifest.json; a single wrapping folder inside the archive is fine. If two packages in the batch share a name, the whole batch is marked invalid — they would install as x and x-2 and there is no telling which one is wanted. Extensions are enabled automatically after installing and can be turned off in the list.
